rv.q: Even more resonant is the mastery of craft on such vivid display.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actor in a Play

vs.sum: The Eugene O'Neill Theatre offers decent sightlines, though some seats may have minor obstructions due to the shallow rake. Sound quality is generally good, ensuring an enjoyable auditory experience. While the comfort level is typical for Broadway, with standard legroom and seat width, the theater's ambiance is enhanced by its elegant Georgian design. Facilities are adequate, with bars and merchandise available on both levels, though restroom capacity may be limited during peak times.

acc.note: No elevators. All accessible seating on Orchestra level. Infrared headsets and audio induction neck loops.
